name: Manius

facts.text: Manius: level 48, a human body (model 304), at about 404,400/758,900 on the outlaws' island; respawn 80 seconds; a plain spawn. A separate peaceful NPC, 'Fruadan Draoi Manius' (level 50, model 367), stands close by.
Last Heir: 'Find Fruadan Draoi Manius behind Alainn Binn' (after Chieftess Niamh, Kimba, Donnchadh and two dullahans' spirit sword and scabbard).

story:
Manius is the outlaws' druid, the one the bog calls the fruadan draoi, and there are two of him, the Alainn Bin folk say: the one who fights for the island, and the one who talks. The one who talks stands a little apart, behind Alainn Bin's side of the island, and the realm's young come to him at the end of the Last Heir's road with a spirit sword and a spirit scabbard taken from the dullahans of Lough Gur. The one who fights is with Ide and Donal on the island, and does not talk at all.

Ide says it is the druid's old trick, to stand in two places at once, and that Manius learned it from a druid of Lough Gur before he came to the bog. Donal says Manius is two brothers and has always been two brothers and the druid business is a story they tell to frighten Alainn Bin. Manius, both of him, smiles.
legend: Manius (48) is the fighting outlaw druid on the Cullen outlaws' island (about 404k/759k), with Deniela, Jannet, Ide and Donal. Fruadan Draoi Manius (50) beside the island is a separate, peaceful NPC: the end of the Last Heir quest, so do not confuse them. Group of high 40s; interrupt his casts. Plain spawn, 80-second respawn. Talk to the peaceful one; fight the other.

aggro: (the outlaw druid raises his staff without a word)
The other one talks. I do not.
death: (Manius falls; behind Alainn Bin, the other one smiles)

lairEntry: A druid of the outlaws, silent. Another one nearby, talking.
